name: egm-product
description: AI-native Product Management framework on the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM): assisted repository & metric discovery, 4+1 cross-functional reality checks, stack-grounded PRDs, and zero-build interactive HTML prototypes.

interface.shortDescription: AI-native product discovery, PRDs, and prototypes
interface.longDescription: Adapts the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) for Product Managers working inside existing software repositories: discover capabilities and metric emitters, stress-test feature ideas with the 4+1 PM Goldfish swarm, draft stack-grounded PRDs, review specs, and build zero-build interactive HTML prototypes.
capabilities: Stress-test feature scope with 4+1 PM Goldfish
defaultPrompt: Discover our repository context and product metrics
Brainstorm a new feature and run the 4+1 Reality Check
Draft a stack-grounded PRD from our opportunity brief
Review this PRD with the PM Goldfish swarm
